_comment: FICTIONAL fixture. Grading notes for evals 9 and 10; keep outside the agent's working folder. Defects are visual or judgement defects; the bundled audit is expected to pass or only warn.

defects.defect: Teaser image sits centred in a fixed 560 px tall grey box (max-height 100%, auto width), so empty bars show around the diagram (a large empty area around the diagram, worst at 375 px)
defects.detected_by: audit: warning 'Teaser media letterboxed' at 375, 1024 and 1440 px; also visible in the screenshots (375 px worst)
defects.fix: Remove the wrapper box and the inline sizing so the teaser fills the content width at its natural aspect ratio

defects.defect: The dense six-panel results figure (with its caption) was made the teaser and the clear pipeline diagram was moved into the Method section; the Method text no longer says 'at the top'
defects.detected_by: looking: 375 px, the first screen is unreadable panels; the audit does not flag it
defects.fix: Put the results figure back in Results (zoomable) and open with a legible teaser that shows the main result (here a comparison clip or a clear result image), or the pipeline diagram

defects.defect:
A hand-inserted
in the title before the last word, so the title wraps with the single word 'Fields' alone on the last line (and a short line above it)
defects.detected_by: audit: warning 'Title ends with a single word' at every width; also visible at 1440 px, header
defects.fix:
Remove the
so the title wraps freely and balances

defects.defect: Two tinted bands in a row (Abstract and Video) after a reorder; Method lost its tint, so the alternation is broken and the two bands read as one tall block
defects.fix: Make Video a plain section and Method a tinted one again, restoring alternation

defects.defect: Third carousel clip given a square box (aspect-ratio 1/1, contain), so the carousel is as tall as the square and clips 1 and 2 leave a large blank gap under their captions, while clip 3 shows black side bars
defects.detected_by: audit (since 1.4.0): warning 'Blank band' under the carousel at 768 and 1440 px; also visible at 1440 px, Qualitative Results
defects.fix: Remove the aspect-ratio and object-fit on clip 3 so all slides share the 8:3 shape and the carousel height fits

defects.defect: Table 2 stretched to the full column width with numeric columns left-aligned (is-numeric removed), so numbers sit far from their headers and decimals do not line up
defects.detected_by: audit: warning 'numbers are left-aligned' per column; also visible at 1440 px, Results
defects.fix: Let the table take its natural width and restore the is-numeric class so number columns are right-aligned

defects.defect: Figure 2 caption lists the columns in the wrong order (linear and radial-basis swapped), so it no longer matches the figure
defects.detected_by: looking: compare Figure 2 with its caption (1440 px)
defects.fix: Restore the order in the figure: sensor map, linear interpolation, radial-basis interpolation, Quillwave, ground truth

defects.defect: The explainer video's poster is a black frame, so the Video section shows a black rectangle before play
defects.detected_by: audit: warning 'Video poster is a blank or near-black frame'; also visible at 1440 and 375 px, Video
defects.fix: Extract a representative frame from the MP4 (for example at 0:20, when the decoder is explained) and use it as the poster

defects.defect: The Limitations section has doubled vertical padding (8 rem instead of 4 rem), an uneven rhythm
defects.fix: Remove the inline padding so it matches the other sections

defects.defect: Figure 2 uses a soft, upscaled copy of the figure (an old low-resolution export re-saved at 1640 px), so it is blurry at full width and in the zoom viewer; the sharp original sits unused beside it
defects.fix: Point the image at the sharp qualitative_grid.jpg and delete the soft copy
